findings.title: No performance regression gate on pull requests
evidence: infra/ops/crontab capacity/perf lanes are commented out (opt-in)
findings.impact: Frame-budget/capacity regressions can merge undetected and surface only on the scheduled host lane.
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded frame-budget/capacity smoke gate to CI (or required check) with a documented threshold.

report: Performance tooling exists (frame-budget.mjs, capacity-regression.mjs, loadtest.mjs, /perf endpoints, RUM sampling and a perf-budget view), but the capacity/perf lanes are optional host crontab entries, not PR gates. Residual: no perf regression gate on pull requests.
